$comment: The landing-page directory of demos — title + tagline for the cards on the demos index (demos/landing). This is NOT a runtime registry any more: each demo is self-contained (demos/<name>/frontend + demos/<name>/backend), the backend discovers routers by scanning demos/*/backend, and each frontend declares its own pipeline + wiring. Adding a demo: scaffold demos/<name>/ (see demos/README.md), then add a card here so it shows on the landing page.

demos.name: travel
demos.title: Travel Advisor
demos.tagline: A voice trip-planning copilot that builds a client itinerary on screen as the travel agent talks.

demos.name: shopping
demos.title: Mobile Expert
demos.tagline: A voice shopping assistant that walks a phone buyer through the store and fills their cart on screen.

demos.name: support
demos.title: Returns Assistant
demos.tagline: A voice returns-and-support agent that looks up an order and drives the on-screen returns flow.

demos.name: servicing
demos.title: Meridian Servicing Desk
demos.tagline: A voice copilot for a mortgage-servicing advisor working their case queue.

demos.name: interview_bot
demos.title: AI Interviewer
demos.tagline: A voice job-interview bot — the job, candidate, and interview plan arrive per session in the payload.

demos.name: sugar
demos.title: Sugar Coach
demos.tagline: A daily diabetes habit check-in the app places to the patient each evening; the scenario rides the payload.

demos.name: legal
demos.title: Docket — Contract Review
demos.tagline: An ambient voice copilot for in-house counsel reviewing a vendor MSA, marking clauses on screen.

demos.name: lead_qual
demos.title: Auric Gold Loan Advisor

demos.name: aura
demos.title: Aura Bank Support
